metadata.task_category: Data Structures - Range Maximum / Brute Force

prompt_text: Write a Java solution for the HackerRank problem Array Pairs.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution uses a nested loop (O(n^2)) which is too slow for large inputs (n up to 100000).
bug_analysis.root_cause: Brute-force approach without using optimized techniques like divide-and-conquer or stack-based segmentation.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Double nested loop iterating over all pairs
